name: lean-quota-monitor
description: Minimal yet powerful monitor for AI subscription quotas and credits in the VS Code Status Bar — Codex, Claude, Gemini, MiniMax, Kimi, GLM, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go, plus customizable script status.

leanQuotaMonitor.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Automatic refresh interval in seconds (minimum: 30, default: 180).

leanQuotaMonitor.statusBarAlignment.description: Status Bar placement: right or left (default: right, restart required).

leanQuotaMonitor.providerOrder.description: Display order for built-in and custom providers. Edit this setting in settings.json; Hover arrow controls update it automatically.

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for OpenAI Codex quota (default: Codex).

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for OpenAI Codex quota (default: GPT).

leanQuotaMonitor.openaiVisible.description: Show OpenAI Codex quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.anthropicProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Anthropic Claude quota (default: Claude).

leanQuotaMonitor.anthropicStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for Anthropic Claude quota (default: CLA).

leanQuotaMonitor.anthropicVisible.description: Show Anthropic Claude quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.geminiProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Google Gemini quota (default: Gemini).

leanQuotaMonitor.geminiStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for Gemini quota (default: AGY).

leanQuotaMonitor.geminiVisible.description: Show Gemini quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.minimaxProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for MiniMax quota (default: MiniMax).

leanQuotaMonitor.minimaxStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for MiniMax quota (default: M3).

leanQuotaMonitor.minimaxVisible.description: Show MiniMax quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.kimiProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Kimi Code quota (default: Kimi).

leanQuotaMonitor.kimiStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for Kimi Code quota (default: KIMI).

leanQuotaMonitor.kimiVisible.description: Show Kimi Code quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.zaiProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for Z.AI GLM Coding Plan quota (default: Z.AI / GLM).

leanQuotaMonitor.zaiStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for Z.AI GLM Coding Plan quota (default: GLM).

leanQuotaMonitor.zaiVisible.description: Show Z.AI GLM Coding Plan quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.openrouterProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for OpenRouter credits (default: OpenRouter).

leanQuotaMonitor.openrouterStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for OpenRouter remaining credits (default: OR).

leanQuotaMonitor.openrouterVisible.description: Show OpenRouter remaining credits in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.opencodeProviderName.description: Display name shown in hover details for OpenCode Go quota (default: OpenCode Go).

leanQuotaMonitor.opencodeStatusBarName.description: Status bar name for OpenCode Go quota (default: OCG).

leanQuotaMonitor.opencodeVisible.description: Show OpenCode Go quota in the Status Bar. Hover details remain visible.

leanQuotaMonitor.customProviders.description: Custom Providers. Key = Provider Name; statusBarName = Status Bar Name; script stdout = Status Output. Scripts must exit 0 and print exactly one non-empty Status Output without the Status Bar Name; rendered Status Bar text is capped at 10 characters.

statusBarName.description: Status Bar Name. The script stdout is the Status Output and must not repeat this name.

script.description: Executable script path; no shell command or arguments.

visible.description: Show this custom provider in the Status Bar. Hover and Quick Pick remain visible.

scripts.lint: biome check src tests package.json biome.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src tests package.json biome.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run compile && pnpm run typecheck:tests
